notes: The Laboratory/Experiments subsystem lives in engine/experiments.py: the setup terminal, pause/resume, the generic cap and day_gate machinery, and effect application. Records carrying 'implemented': true are live; the rest are inert and carry meta.blocked_on naming what each still needs. Live triggers fire from engine/experiments.py (immediately), Game._place_room via on_room_drafted (the five draft-site triggers), special_items.open_container (trunks_opened) and two sites in game.py (security_door). See docs/experiments-design.md for the phase plan and its Status section for the current live counts -- that section, not this note, is the one kept in step with each PR.

Deliberately never modelled, at any future phase (see docs/experiments-design.md): the 40-second real-time trigger and the map-view trigger (no wall-clock or interactive map action in this simulator); the setup-menu reroll timing exploit (revisiting the Experimental Setup menu before committing to reroll the three-of-each draw -- a UI-timing exploit, not a data rule); Blessing of the Tinkerer cross-triggers (any active experiment also triggers whenever a Mechanical Room is drafted, independent of the chosen trigger -- a global modifier on the whole subsystem, not a per-record rule); radiation level (a hidden daily counter, incremented by every successful trigger, that gates the Shelter terminal's unlock-all-doors ability -- Shelter/radiation are out of scope); Dare Mode (an alternate, harder experiments ruleset documented on a separate wiki subpage); Research Logs (an in-fiction in-game log of experiment activation history, not a mechanical system).

mechanic.setup: Three experimental triggers and three experimental effects are chosen uniformly from the available pool at the Laboratory terminal; the player picks one of each to form the day's experiment.
mechanic.packet_note: The Satellite Dish data packet permanently adds the 8 packet triggers and 8 packet effects to the pool, bringing each to 20; Packet Management then lets the player choose which >=8 of each may appear. Phases 5-8 (out of scope for this data pass).

triggers.text: Immediately,

notes: Triggers exactly once, at the moment the experiment is started.

triggers.text: Each time you eat an apple,

meta.blocked_on: phase 0: no experiments engine exists yet (data/validation only)
notes: Counts green apples and apples-with-leaves consumed for steps; no other fruit counts. The steps from the apple are gained before the experimental effect applies.

triggers.text: Whenever you draft a Shop room,

notes: All Shops count. Can loop with the Aquariums effect. With Blessing of the Tinkerer active, drafting the Electric Eel Aquarium triggers this twice (most triggers do not double this way) -- a cross-trigger interaction, deliberately not modelled per the phase 0 scope note on Blessing of the Tinkerer.

triggers.text: Each time you unlock or bypass a security door,

availability.text: If Veteran Mode is not enabled, this trigger cannot appear before Day 8.

notes: A security door must be drafted FROM to count; merely unlocking one is not enough.
"Opening a security door in a different room by drafting into it also counts for this experimental trigger."

Wiki also hedges that this 'occasionally triggers an additional time at the start of the draft, possibly due to a bug,' with no rate given; magnitude.undocumented_extra_fire_rate_pct left null (gap -- do not invent) and deliberately not modelled.

triggers.text: Whenever you spend 2 or more gems drafting a room,

notes: Applies to whichever rooms currently cost >=2 gems to draft -- the wiki page resolves this via a live Cargo query (Gem_cost>=2 AND NOT Type HOLDS 'Upgrade'), not a static id list, so no room id list is transcribed here. Waived if a room's gem cost is removed (e.g. by the Emerald Bracelet); gems spent elsewhere during drafting (e.g. the Study's option) do not count.

triggers.text: For each Bedroom you draft after your second,

notes: Wiki: "The first two Bedrooms drafted do not count for this trigger, but each Bedroom drafted afterwards does. It does matter whether those two initial Bedrooms are drafted before or after starting the experiment." That last sentence never says which way it matters and the wiki gives no further detail -- it has never been grammatically clean. Owner ruling: this sim counts all of today's Bedrooms toward the two-Bedroom threshold, whether drafted before or after the experiment started.
The Bunk Room counts twice, and can by itself satisfy both of the 'first two' -- if drafted with exactly one other Bedroom already in the house, the experiment triggers once.

triggers.text: Whenever you draft an 'archived' floorplan,

availability.text: If Veteran Mode is not enabled, this trigger cannot appear until you have drafted an Archives at least once.

meta.blocked_on: needs its fire site: DraftOption.archived now distinguishes an archived floorplan from a merely concealed one, so the trigger fires when the player chooses an option carrying that flag.
notes: Requires first drafting the Archives (whose effect hides floorplans during drafting) and then drafting one of the hidden ones. An archived Bunk Room triggers twice.

triggers.text: The next 3 times you unlock and open a chest,

notes: 'Chest' is wiki terminology for trunk; counts both key-unlocks and Sledge-Hammer-equivalent smashes. Fires for containers.kinds 'trunk' and the dead 'chest' kind (no room currently references it); does not fire for lockers, the Garage car trunk, or Vault deposit boxes, which are distinct mechanics.

triggers.text: When you draft a Hallway from another Hallway,

notes: Counts Hallways of all kinds, not just the base Hallway room.

triggers.text: Each time you find some trash while digging,

availability.text: If Veteran Mode is not enabled, this trigger cannot appear until the first time you obtain a Shovel.

notes: Six wiki-listed trash kinds (rock, pebbles, tin can, brick, shoe, nail) plus Scraps of Paper (Patch 1.6+). Digging up 'nothing' does not count. Fires from special_items.dig_all's per-spot loop on a 'junk' table outcome; both dig tables already fold Scraps of Paper into a second junk row, so no separate handling is needed for the Patch 1.6 addition. The item_obtained_gate availability (first Shovel obtained) is not enforced -- only day_gate is -- so this trigger is always offerable; veteran_mode (default True) would bypass the gate anyway.
